chunks: He said: Zaid al-Shahham and others narrated, saying: I heard Salim say: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) say:
Indeed, the Almighty Allah presented the life history of the Qaim of the Family of Muhammad to Musa ibn Imran; and he mentioned the tradition.

key_terms.قَائِم: The Riser (referring to the Twelfth Imam)

ai.seo_question: What did Allah show Musa ibn Imran regarding the Qaim of the Family of Muhammad?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Kitab al-Ghayba*, highlights the divine pre-ordination of the Twelfth Imam’s mission by presenting his 'sira' (life history/characteristics) to Prophet Musa (a.s.), thereby linking the Mahdi’s occultation to prophetic precedent. It serves as a crucial theological proof for the Imamate of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that the Qaim’s emergence is a predetermined divine event known to previous prophets. The narration underscores the continuity of divine guidance across eras, reinforcing the Shia belief in the hidden Imam’s authority even during his concealment.
